title: Replicating the Voynich Manuscript (open companion to the 2004 table-and-grille paper)
summary: Rugg's archived Keele site outlines the method introduced in his January 2004 Cryptologia paper. A perforated card selects fragments from a structured table to make text that resembles the manuscript without using a plaintext.
established: Rugg's open worked explanation uses repeating sets of prefix, middle and suffix columns and a grille whose holes reveal selected cells. Blank cells permit shorter strings. Example and procedure at https://hydeandrugg.wordpress.com/2014/03/02/hoaxing-the-voynich-manuscript-part-7-producing-the-text/.
The paper reports preliminary production-time estimates, and the companion site documents a feasibility demonstration. Rugg's proposed dating and attribution are historical hypotheses.
